target.rawSql:
select r.started_at as time, g.kpi || ' ' || coalesce(g.dims->>'module','') || ': ' || round(g.value::numeric,1) || ' vs ' || round(g.baseline_median::numeric,1) || ' | ' || coalesce(g.compare_url,'') as text, 'regression' as tags
from regression g join run r on r.id=g.run_id
where r.kind='BUILD' and r.source='branch' and $__timeFilter(r.started_at) and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring})

select started_at as time, 'segment ' || prev || ' -> ' || segment as text, 'segment' as tags
from (select started_at, branch, segment, lag(segment) over (partition by branch order by started_at) as prev
      from run where kind='BUILD' and source='branch') s
where prev is not null and prev <> segment and $__timeFilter(started_at) and branch in (${branch:sqlstring})

targets.rawSql:
select r.started_at as time, m.dims->>'module' || ' (' || r.branch || ', ' || r.segment || ')' as metric, m.value
from measurement m join run r on r.id=m.run_id
where m.kpi='test.module.duration' and r.kind='BUILD' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
order by 1

panels.title: Engine module test time

targets.rawSql:
select r.started_at as time, r.branch || ' (' || r.segment || ')' as metric, m.value
from measurement m join run r on r.id=m.run_id
where m.kpi='test.module.duration' and m.dims->>'module'='engine' and r.kind='BUILD' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
order by 1

select r.started_at as time, s.name as metric, s.v as value
from run r
join lateral (
  select array_agg(h.v) as vs from (
    select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m2.value) as v
    from run r2 join measurement m2 on m2.run_id=r2.id
    where r2.kind='BUILD' and r2.source='branch' and r2.status='SUCCESS' and r2.branch=r.branch and r2.segment=r.segment and r2.db is not distinct from r.db and r2.benchmark is not distinct from r.benchmark and m2.kpi='test.module.duration' and m2.dims->>'module'='engine'
      and (r2.started_at, r2.id) < (r.started_at, r.id)
    group by r2.id, r2.started_at order by r2.started_at desc, r2.id desc limit 10) h) b on true
join lateral (select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by x) as med from unnest(b.vs) x) md on true
join lateral (select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by abs(x - md.med)) as mad from unnest(b.vs) x) d on true
cross join lateral (values ('noise band hi', md.med + greatest(3 * d.mad, 0.03 * md.med, 1.0)),
                           ('noise band lo', md.med - greatest(3 * d.mad, 0.03 * md.med, 1.0))) s(name, v)
where r.kind='BUILD' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.branch=${band:sqlstring} and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and cardinality(b.vs) >= 5 and $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
order by 1

panels.description: Gray area: noise band of the scheduled runs of the noise-band branch (same segment): median of the previous 10 runs +- max(3 x MAD, 3% of the median, 1 s), the regression detector's threshold. Shown once 5 earlier runs exist. Manual/bisect commit runs are excluded.

panels.title: Total build wall time

targets.rawSql:
select r.started_at as time, r.branch || ' (' || r.segment || ')' as metric, m.value
from measurement m join run r on r.id=m.run_id
where m.kpi='build.total.wall' and r.kind='BUILD' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
order by 1

select r.started_at as time, s.name as metric, s.v as value
from run r
join lateral (
  select array_agg(h.v) as vs from (
    select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m2.value) as v
    from run r2 join measurement m2 on m2.run_id=r2.id
    where r2.kind='BUILD' and r2.source='branch' and r2.status='SUCCESS' and r2.branch=r.branch and r2.segment=r.segment and r2.db is not distinct from r.db and r2.benchmark is not distinct from r.benchmark and m2.kpi='build.total.wall'
      and (r2.started_at, r2.id) < (r.started_at, r.id)
    group by r2.id, r2.started_at order by r2.started_at desc, r2.id desc limit 10) h) b on true
join lateral (select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by x) as med from unnest(b.vs) x) md on true
join lateral (select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by abs(x - md.med)) as mad from unnest(b.vs) x) d on true
cross join lateral (values ('noise band hi', md.med + greatest(3 * d.mad, 0.03 * md.med, 30.0)),
                           ('noise band lo', md.med - greatest(3 * d.mad, 0.03 * md.med, 30.0))) s(name, v)
where r.kind='BUILD' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.branch=${band:sqlstring} and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and cardinality(b.vs) >= 5 and $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
order by 1

panels.description: Gray area: noise band of the scheduled runs of the noise-band branch (same segment): median of the previous 10 runs +- max(3 x MAD, 3% of the median, 30 s), the regression detector's threshold. Shown once 5 earlier runs exist. Manual/bisect commit runs are excluded.

panels.title: Top 20 slowest engine test classes (last run)

targets.rawSql:
with last as (
  select r.id from run r where r.kind='BUILD' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(r.started_at) order by r.started_at desc limit 1)
select m.dims->>'class' as "class", m.value as seconds
from measurement m join last on m.run_id=last.id
where m.kpi='test.class.duration' and m.dims->>'module'='engine'
order by m.value desc limit 20

select r.started_at as time, r.branch || ' (' || r.segment || ')' as metric, m.value
from measurement m join run r on r.id=m.run_id
where m.kpi='test.class.duration' and m.dims->>'module'='engine' and m.dims->>'class'=${class:sqlstring} and r.kind='BUILD' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
order by 1
